title: Sample known-exploited vulnerabilities — FICTIONAL DEMO FIXTURE (not CISA data; vendors, products and IDs are made up)

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Woodgrove SQL Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (sample)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sample (fictional). Woodgrove SQL contains a remote code execution vulnerability allowing an authenticated attacker to execute commands on the host.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply the May 2026 cumulative update per vendor instructions.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Adatum Networks AdatumOS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability (sample)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sample (fictional). The AdatumOS management interface contains an authentication bypass enabling unauthenticated remote attackers to gain administrator privileges.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade AdatumOS per vendor advisory; restrict the management interface to internal addresses.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fabrikam Automation FabView Operator Station Privilege Escalation Vulnerability (sample)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sample (fictional). FabView Operator Station contains a privilege escalation vulnerability allowing a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges on the HMI host.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply the April 2026 FabView security update.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: LitwareOS Service-Restart Helper Privilege Escalation Vulnerability (sample)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sample (fictional). The LitwareOS service-restart helper allows local attackers to escalate privileges via unsanitized environment variables.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Update the service-restart helper package; review local privilege boundaries.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: VanArsdel Controls VC-1500 Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (sample)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sample (fictional). VanArsdel Controls VC-1500 CPUs allow unauthenticated remote code execution over unencrypted engineering protocols.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply firmware 3.0.0+; isolate engineering traffic to protected network segments.
